questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Some verses of the Qur'an are marked with a symbol at which the reciter stops and prostrates during recitation. This prostration is called
questions.explanation: The mark in the mushaf tells him to bow at once.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The six most famous collections of hadith — Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, and the four sunan — are together known as
questions.explanation: Six books stand above all others in the science.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Four months of the Islamic year — Dhul-Qa'dah, Dhul-Hijjah, Muharram and Rajab — in which fighting is forbidden are called
questions.explanation: Even the tribes of old laid down arms in them.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The practice of reciting Qur'anic verses, such as al-Fatihah and the last two surahs, as a prayer for healing from illness is called
questions.explanation: The Prophet himself recited and blew over the sick.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The Prophet (SAW) taught that smiling in the face of your brother is counted as
questions.explanation: Even a cheerful face earns a reward.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Removing a harmful object, such as thorns or broken glass, from the path of people is taught in Islam as a branch of
questions.D: faith and an act of charity
questions.explanation: A clear road is itself a form of kindness.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Long before Islam, the Prophet's grandfather Abdul Muttalib was honoured in Makkah for
questions.B: rediscovering the buried well of Zamzam
questions.C: building the first mosque at Quba
questions.D: writing the first book of hadith
questions.explanation: He cleared the buried spring and served its water.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The Prophet (SAW) was known in Madinah by his kunya, or filial title,
questions.explanation: He was called after his little son Qasim.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Raising one's voice in search of a lost item, quarrelling loudly or buying and selling inside the mosque go against the
questions.explanation: The house of Allah is for prayer and quiet counsel.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.topic: At-Tawhid and the Articles of Faith
questions.q: Reliance on Allah after one has taken the proper lawful means, trusting that His plan is best, is called
questions.explanation: Tie your camel, then commit its safety to Him.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Calling people to what is right and speaking against what is wrong, with wisdom and patience, is the duty known as
questions.explanation: The ummah's conscience lives by this duty.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The wives of the Prophet (SAW), whom the Qur'an honours and who are forbidden to any man after him, are called
questions.explanation: Every believer honours them as his mothers.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Among the books of hadith, the collection of Imam al-Bukhari is regarded by the scholars as
questions.A: a book of law and tafsir only
questions.B: the most authentic book after the Qur'an
questions.C: the earliest book of fiqh known
questions.explanation: Its chain-checking set the standard for all.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The Prophet (SAW) said that if the Day of Resurrection comes while one of you holds a seedling, he should plant it if he can. The hadith teaches
questions.A: the duty to predict the Last Day
questions.C: the value of work and hope to the very end
questions.explanation: Plant even at the end of the world.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Near the end of time, a great deceiver will appear working false wonders and leading many astray. In the hadith he is called
questions.explanation: The Prophet sought refuge from his trials.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The two vast nations of destructiveness that will be released near the end of time and spread corruption are named in the Qur'an as
questions.explanation: Their breach is one of the great signs.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.topic: At-Tawhid and the Articles of Faith
questions.q: The belief that the grave may hold questioning and either comfort or punishment for the dead before the Day of Resurrection is called
questions.explanation: What answers the dead give matters at once.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: When a Muslim dies, the community's duty towards the body includes washing it, wrapping it in white cloth and burying it quickly. The white cloth is the
questions.explanation: Simple white cloth is the last garment.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Visiting the family of the deceased to console them and pray for their dead, without wailing or extravagance, is called
questions.explanation: Standing with the bereaved lightens their load.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The companion who narrated the largest number of hadith from the Prophet (SAW), thanks to his constant companionship, is
questions.explanation: Over five thousand reports bear his chain.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The Prophet (SAW) commanded that one should eat and drink with the right hand, because the left hand is used by
questions.explanation: Even at table, the right hand leads.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: A prostration of gratitude performed outside prayer when a blessing arrives or a calamity is averted is called
questions.explanation: The thankful forehead touches the ground at once.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The words of remembrance a Muslim recites at dawn and at dusk, glorifying Allah and seeking His protection, are called
questions.explanation: Morning and evening are the two guarded times.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: A voluntary prayer of two or more rak'ahs performed in the forenoon, after the sun has risen high, is called
questions.explanation: Its time begins as the morning climbs.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Invoking Allah's blessings and peace upon the Prophet (SAW), as the Qur'an commands the believers to do, is called
questions.explanation: One blessing from us draws ten from Allah.
